canDoYue: 你識話走廊嘈音搞到你瞓唔著、問維修十點檢查、問可唔可以搬去靜啲嘅套房，同埋問維修幾點做完。
canDoEn: Say the hallway noise kept you up, ask for a quieter suite, and ask when maintenance finishes.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The hallway noise kept me up, and I couldn't sleep at all.
dialogue.glossYue: 走廊嘈音搞到我瞓唔著。
dialogue.say: The hallway noise kept me up, and I couldn't sleep at all.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that noise. Maintenance can check the room at ten.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思。維修十點可以檢查間房。
dialogue.say: I'm sorry about that noise. Maintenance can check the room at ten.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could I move to a quieter suite if the hallway stays this loud?
dialogue.glossYue: 走廊如果仲大聲，可唔可以搬去靜啲嘅套房？
dialogue.say: Could I move to a quieter suite if the hallway stays this loud?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: A quieter suite is free upstairs, away from that hallway.
dialogue.glossYue: 樓上有間靜啲嘅房，遠離走廊。
dialogue.say: A quieter suite is free upstairs, away from that hallway.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can that new room face the harbor instead of the street?
dialogue.glossYue: 新房間可唔可以望海港，唔好望街？
dialogue.say: Can that new room face the harbor instead of the street?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: The harbor suite is ready, and I can move your bag there.
dialogue.glossYue: 海港套房準備好，我可以幫你搬行李。
dialogue.say: The harbor suite is ready, and I can move your bag there.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: What time will maintenance finish if I keep this suite?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我留呢間套房，維修幾點做完？
dialogue.say: What time will maintenance finish if I keep this suite?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Maintenance will finish at noon, and the harbor room stays held.
dialogue.glossYue: 維修中午做完，海港嗰間房會留住。
dialogue.say: Maintenance will finish at noon, and the harbor room stays held.
